name: Single-Event Upset (SEU) Fault Injection in 3DGS
definition: A fault model where a single transient bit flip in GPU memory representing a trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) primitive parameter is simulated to measure rendering corruption.
summary: Single-Event Upset fault injection in 3D Gaussian Splatting simulates transient GPU bit flips to measure rendering corruption, distinguishing itself by testing spatially localized primitives rather than globally shared neural network weights.
